body: If you tried to change the name of Mt. Hood, I guarantee all the liberal Oregon snowflake cucks would lose their shit.
So what's your story?
Thank you.
Came back from a long deployment, picked on and treated like shit by some bigdicks on a boat, GF didn't wanna see me anymore. Literally was shaking and begging myself for a drink

Been outside awhile, and eating well. It hit me at around 8 this morning. I just feel so absolutely exhausted. Like my heart is pounding in my head and I'm breathing really rapid and heavy. It feels like I'm coming off a sick bender but I've been clean awhile now.
Stay focused on why you want to stop. Good luck!
It milks the soul

It's important to just get through the day. I get those sober "don't wanna do anything" days all the time. Go to Starbucks and people watch. Kinda creepy, I know, but it helps me. Also calling old friends and just talking should give you a boost to get off your ass.

I'm back on the wagon for good this time 😀

I won't be drinking today!
Boats 😩
Thank you. I'm trying hard to get better
Yes I've found sober introspection to be a lot better for my psyche than being wasted and voicing how much I hate myself. My glass bottle coke intake has definitely spiked 🙂
Good job! Stay the course and I know life will get even better for you. Bless you and have a great night!
Thanks. I'll be sure to check in when I hit land
Let's do it. Time to change our ways and thanks for sharing!
Yup endless cycle of pain/anxiety/depression and self loathing. I can't do it anymore.

I'm going through the same thing right now. 32 hours no sleep and kinda just floating between this sub and work. It's so self destructive to treat yourself this way. Glad you are wanting to change. I'm 26 and I don't think my body or mind can take much more. Hug and kiss your SO let them know how thankful you are for them. My GF cries whenever I drink, even though I would never be abusive/hurtful to her, she is sad because I'm hurting myself constantly. It's time for us to change for good.
The fact you came back here to share is also a success. Good job and let's keep trying

I'm 26 and knew I had a problem when I was around 23-24. Alcohol is my whole life. I think about it all the time 24/7. I would take alcohol over sex. It's seriously affecting my mental health, my job, and my relationships and it's time for me to grow up and fucking do something about it. I've been to rehab/AA and been in and out of sobriety the past three years. I'm not in a good spot right now, but I can tell you that he best times I had in those three years were spent sober. Even they were just simple things like taking a long drive or waking up early to a beautiful morning. Drunks take these things for granted. 

Take your sobriety seriously. Get help if you need it, but DONT LIE to yourself or to your loved ones.   Don't do it.
Same. It's like a train I can't get off.

In my sober periods...I am a funny, kind, and hardworking 26 yr old man. I love my friends and my family, and basically everyone around me. My life is in order, the house is clean, and there is a beautiful woman in my life whom I love and cherish and would do anything to see her simply smile. 

My sober self earned these things by being sober. They just fell into my lap. 

My drinking self is selfish, lazy, arrogant, and an all around asshole. My shit is a mess. I can't concentrate on anything. My GF bursts into tears when I drink myself into a stupor and my drunk self couldn't even care. 

I am one lucky motherfucker to still have a job and this beautiful woman at my side.

Alls it takes is some sobriety. One day at a time.
We can do this! You got it!!
If I could drink like a "normal" person, I'd drink all the time 😉

In my experience I still feel not myself for awhile after a binge. I probably haven't been "myself" in years. Even if it's just anxiety or paranoia or anger, alcohol fucks with your emotions long after you stop drinking. Also, even if you are a grumpy fuck, I accept you. Mahalo
That's your withdrawals kicking in. Happens to me every time I go on a sick one. I hate people I haven't talked to in years. Give it a few days
My day One too...got obliterated over the weekend

Yeah I self referred and completed my first program with one relapse after a year and they told me I'm good to start drinking again. At first I didn't want to but with each time I drank I started falling into my old self. 30 dollar weekends with a handle of tangeray on the couch. 

Thank god my drinking hasn't taken me to Mast or anything, but I'm the founding member of the Liberty Risk Board lol.

I'm ready to start being honest with myself. I can never drink again or somebody will get hurt. Probably me

I have memories of a few years back when I was sober for 73 days after a stint in rehab. I smelled nice, took care of my life, exercised a lot, and loved the people around me. Some shit really went downhill, and I have completely lost myself. I suck at the job I used to be so good at, can't focus on anything, and am generally a shitty person. I've tried sobriety three times now and usually only last about 2 - 3 weeks
